title: Provider-neutral Model Infrastructure Manager for text, image, voice and cloud ML
observation: Operator explicitly requested a plug-and-play model/compute layer that automatically researches new models, intelligently routes between subscription, API, open-weight and abliterated models, manages cloud GPU capacity such as RunPod, supports image/voice workloads and ML/LoRA training, quotes/budgets work before paid execution, and as of 2026-10-01 should aggressively maximize useful OpenRouter free-model capacity before paid inference.
suspected_root_cause: Current routing is provider/model aware but does not yet own cloud compute lifecycle, multimodal/training workloads, live pricing, quote/budget planning, or a continuous plug-and-play model catalog.
suggested_direction: Implement the phased roadmap in model-infrastructure-manager.md. ASAP first slice: FreeComputeBroker with dynamic OpenRouter free-model discovery, read-only quota/credit visibility, quota governor, empirically specialized free-first routing for verifiable tasks, bounded alternate-free escalation, useful quota backfill, and operator top-up recommendation only when current provider policy/account state shows it is actually required. Then continue the existing provider-neutral RunPod/runtime/model-research plan.
acceptance: New text/code models can be added without scheduler changes
Image and voice/audio models are first-class capability types
RunPod can be quoted and later provisioned through a provider-neutral compute interface
Paid jobs respect hard project/job budgets and approval gates
Credentials are configured locally and never committed
Training/LoRA requests produce intelligent low/expected/high quotes before launch
Abliterated foreman routing can be evaluated in shadow mode against incumbent routes
Continuous research can discover and benchmark future model releases
OpenRouter free models are discovered dynamically and empirically specialized by task family
Verifiable low-risk work can route free-first with independent validators and bounded escalation
Free-request quota/RPM/reset state is governed so failed retries cannot silently burn the allowance
Orchestrator measures useful progress per free request and paid fallbacks/cost avoided
OpenRouter top-up is recommended only when current verified policy and observed account state justify it; purchases remain approval-gated
risks: Provider APIs and model metadata change quickly; adapters and research records must be versioned
An experimental/abliterated foreman must not become the authorization or spending boundary
Cloud idle time, retries and artifact storage can create hidden cost if not included in quotes
Free-model availability, quotas, context limits and provider data policies are volatile; discovery and policy provenance must be refreshed rather than hard-coded
notes: High priority. ASAP operator directive 2026-10-01: maximize useful OpenRouter free-model capacity before paid inference. Begin with no-cost/read-only discovery, quota/account visibility, quota governor and verifiable free-first routing. Current OpenRouter policy values must be versioned/provenanced, and any credit purchase or auto-recharge remains explicit user-approved spend.
